trigger_conditions: When buy-side and sell-side big trade clusters appear within a narrow range
(2–3 ticks), Andrea Cimi classifies this phenomenon as a **"liquidity pocket"**
or a state of **"pure war"** between big institutional participants [1, 2].
This scenario indicates a **balanced market** where aggressive buyers and
outcome: sellers are fighting for control, but their efforts are being neutralized by passive limit orders (absorption) on both sides [2, 3]. It represents an area where huge amounts of money are being exchanged, but the market has not yet reached an agreement on a new fair price [4, 5]. ### **Is it a "No-Trade"?** In many cases, yes.
